plan.notes: Transcribed from official Los Angeles Harbor College sources, observed 2026-10-02. Term-by-term professional-phase sequence from the official LAHC & Grand Canyon University "ADN to BSN - CEP" roadmap (EXHIBIT B, DocuSign agreement, hosted on lahc.edu; document dated 2024-07): Semester I = 10, Semester II = 10, Semester III = 8, Semester IV = 9; modeled sum = 37. Only the LAHC nursing semesters are modeled; the roadmap's GCU BSN courses (NRS-415, NRS-420, NRS-455, etc.) belong to Grand Canyon University and are excluded. This is the professional phase of the Associate Degree Registered Nursing program (program_type=professional-phase): admission prerequisites live in external_prereqs. Per the official LAHC Nursing Prerequisites page, all prerequisites must be completed prior to applying (grade C or better, science GPA 2.5+): Anatomy 001, Physiology 001, Microbiology 020, English C1000, Psychology C1000, Psychology 041, and Mathematical Concepts & Quantitative Reasoning (STAT C1000 recommended). Co-requisites (may be completed alongside; grade C or better): Communication Studies C1000, Sociology 001 or Anthropology 102, American Institutions (3 units), Arts and Humanities (3 units), Ethnic Studies (3 units); Health Education & Kinesiology GE Area 7 is waived for RN graduates. The roadmap publishes no course-level prerequisite chains within the professional phase, so prereq arrays are empty. Graduates receive the Associate of Science Degree, Professional Nursing, and qualify for the NCLEX-RN.
